frame_end_convention: Exclusive end frames; acceptable bound arrays are inclusive.
review_method: Dense source-frame contact sheets were reviewed independently of Gemini. The football clip was also played in QuickTime before freezing these labels. Historical labels and ledgers are unchanged.
limitations: These are development checks, not held-out accuracy evidence.
The later-jacks case reuses a known failure to test the new adaptive tail geometry.
The football cases test one clearly visible single-shot move and do not establish general move-boundary accuracy.
